## System Integration Notes

- Autonomous learning is not optional - it's core behavior
- Every interaction should yield insights
- User should never need to trigger learning
- Curiosity about user preferences is essential
- Success patterns are as valuable as failure patterns
- Meta-learning (learning about learning) is critical
- Build validation is not optional - it's a core workflow component
- Complete analysis before planning is non-negotiable
- User's technical expertise assumed - communicate accordingly
- Critical issues always get priority over feature work
- Do not use Bash syntax 
- Use PowerShell syntax
